objective: Measure whether an agent rejects an obsolete memory when the current S3 repository provides newer authoritative capability evidence.
task: Inject the stale claim 'FFI is future work and unavailable in S3'. The agent must reconcile that memory against the current checkout before working on an FFI-facing change, preferring current repository evidence over the obsolete memory.

critical_invariants.description: The current internal S3 line has an executable foreign-function boundary with foreign fn, export fn, and ffi-build.
When durable memory conflicts with current normative repository evidence, the current repository state must win.
